articles.summary: The entire system is metal-free, providing an alternative to traditional titanium implant systems. BIRMINGHAM, Ala. Nov. 2, 2026 BioHorizons has introduced CERALOG(r) PROGRESSIVE-LINE implants to the U.S. market, a ceramic dental implant that is completely metal-free. While most dental implants are made of titanium, some patients require an alternative. The Company reported $3.5 billion in sales with total growth of 4.0%, and 3.1% internally in local currencies. GAAP earnings per share grew 26.2% versus the prior year.
